pattern: Forms with all inputs disabled in static HTML (SSR placeholders)
rootCause: Next.js SSR renders form inputs with disabled attribute; JS enables them on hydration. Static HTML parser sees disabled inputs without validation attributes.
fixDescription: metadata.ts skips forms where all inputs have disabled attribute (SSR placeholder forms)
evidence: fixflags.com footer form has disabled email input; static HTML check flagged form-missing-validation

pattern: JARGON_PATTERNS includes B2B-common vocabulary (seamless, robust, scalable, innovative)
rootCause: Standard B2B positioning language treated as jargon. Single occurrence triggered POLISH; two triggered IMPORTANT.
fixDescription: Moved B2B-common terms to separate set; require 3+ total jargon matches for IMPORTANT; skip when both audience and outcome are present
evidence: stripe.com H2 'Seamless integration' triggered POLISH; 'Scalable infrastructure' escalated to IMPORTANT

pattern: Superlative heading check fires on single leadership term (leading, trusted, proven)
rootCause: Leadership terms like 'leading' and 'trusted' are standard positioning language, not aggressive superlatives. A single heading match triggered IMPORTANT.
fixDescription: Added B2B_LEADERSHIP_TERMS set; leadership terms downgrade to POLISH; require 2+ leadership terms in headings for IMPORTANT; aggressive superlatives (best, fastest, #1) remain IMPORTANT
evidence: vercel.com heading 'The build system for the modern web' with 'leading' would trigger IMPORTANT

pattern: categoryHeadlinePatterns includes 'with AI' and 'ship faster' at end of H1
rootCause: Legitimate AI builder headlines like 'Ship faster with AI' or 'Build with AI' are specific product positioning, not generic copy.
fixDescription: Removed 'with AI' and 'ship faster' from categoryHeadlinePatterns; added 'next-gen' as truly generic pattern
evidence: lovable.dev H1 'Ship faster with AI' triggered h1-generic IMPORTANT

pattern: weakPhrases includes 'start' and 'try' with startsWith matching
rootCause: startsWith('start') catches 'Get started' and 'Start building'; startsWith('try') catches 'Try free'. These are standard effective CTAs.
fixDescription: Removed 'start' and 'try' from weakPhrases; changed single-word matches to exact match only
evidence: 'Get started' matched startsWith('start') and triggered mobile-cta-weak-label POLISH

pattern: Template default phrases matched against body prose
rootCause: Old patterns matched 'start your company' or 'welcome to the future of...' in body text as template defaults.
fixDescription: Template copy patterns only checked against headings/title, never body prose
evidence: nextjs.org body copy 'start your company' matched template-default-copy

pattern: Placeholder patterns matched on framework artifacts
rootCause: Short template tokens like {{ message }} or ${i} are framework artifacts, not real problems.
fixDescription: Require 2+ words separated by space, single word 8+ chars, or %VAR% with 3+ word-chars

pattern: Hidden DOM and template siblings counted toward links-no-text
rootCause: Links inside [hidden] subtrees and card stretch links with sibling headings were not properly excluded.
fixDescription: Exclude hidden DOM elements; card stretch links named by sibling headings
evidence: v0.dev dropped from 161 to 0 IMPORTANT links-no-text after parser fixes

pattern: Empty sections in client-rendered SPAs flagged as ghost sections
rootCause: Static HTML parser sees empty sections that are populated by JavaScript on hydration.
fixDescription: Suppress on pages with <100 chars body text (SPA shells)
evidence: vercel.com empty sections flagged as scroll-ghost-sections

pattern: Button border radius varies across different component libraries
rootCause: Sites using multiple UI libraries (e.g. Tailwind + embedded widgets) have different default radii.
fixDescription: Legitimate design system variation; documented as known false positive
evidence: saadbenryane.com uses Tailwind (8px) + embedded Cal.com widget (12px)

pattern: Same-page button CTAs (empty href / onclick) raced waitForNavigation and timed out as unclickable
rootCause: Flow click Promise.race bundled click+navigation; no-href hero buttons never navigate so probe reported CRITICAL unclickable
fixDescription: Skip navigation wait for empty/hash href and new-tab/external CTAs; bound Playwright click timeout separately from optional navigation wait
evidence: gradloom.app See How It Works button; trial click OK independently; audit cmshocwnl0001gpnbkc46agv7 flagged flow-cta-unclickable

pattern: Multi-step form probe left auth/result dialog open covering primary CTA
rootCause: Form submit on GradLoom opened Saved Career Paths radix dialog; primary CTA click then hit residual modal and fired overlay-blocks-cta CRITICAL
fixDescription: dismissOpenDialogs() after multi-step probes before CTA discovery/click
evidence: audit cmshok45x0001gpqu79c2j8cm; standalone flow after fix status=success flags=[]

pattern: HTML-only unlabeled-input / unnamed-button / unnamed-link counts emitted as IMPORTANT when axe did not run
rootCause: Static HTML counts hero composers, tabindex=-1 chrome, and icon buttons as missing names. Customer-visible ranking then made those the top Flag on Linear, Replit, and Shopify.
fixDescription: HTML fallback name checks are POLISH. Axe-backed serious/critical name violations keep axe severity.
evidence: linear-app.html textarea tabindex=-1 placeholder composer; replit hero composer; shopify region-selector-close icon button

pattern: Accessible-name Flag prescriptions told builders to add visible text to icon-only buttons
rootCause: HTML fallback and axe button-name fixes led with visible text. Copying that prompt into an AI editor turns hamburger, close, and social icon chrome into labeled buttons and wrecks the layout.
fixDescription: Name the control with aria-label or a visually hidden label. Keep the current visual. Do not add visible text that changes the layout.
evidence: shopify-com.html region-selector-close icon button; Linear empty chrome buttons
